info.name: Are You Sure You Can Leave?

descriptions.notStarted: Apparently, #p1101002# wants to tell me something...
descriptions.inProgress: #p1101002# told me I may be a knight, but I still have a long way to go before he can send me out on assignments, and asked me to train more.
descriptions.completed: #p1101002# told me I may be a knight, but I still have a long way to go before he can send me out on assignments, and he asked me to train more with the help from #p1102000# the Training Instructor...
